card.name: Digits in papal reign years
card.fires_on: A single digit inside a year number (such as 1143, 1585 or 561) in text about popes and church history. It also fires on digits in church-document citations.

modes.label: Years in pope lists
modes.description: A middle digit of a year in a pope's reign dates.

modes.label: Years in church history prose
modes.description: A digit of a year in sentences about popes, bulls or consecrations.

modes.description: A digit or period in references to theological works or church documents.
